channel.title: Pier & Point · Pier 70 Parcel A
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Pier 70 Parcel A (Pier 70), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel A: The 2042 date on this record was drawn as an expected completion. The Port's 2017 staff report calls it an outside date in the Development Agreement's Schedule of Performance (Phase 3 within approximately 25 years of approval), not a construction schedule. It is now labelled a legal deadline and no longer moves this record's status on the map or the timeline.

Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Item%209B%20Pier%2070%20Approval%20092217.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Pier 70 Parcel A: The Phase 1 schedule is now described as tolled by the down market delay (extended to December 26, 2026, Port Item 11A) rather than lapsed, with the 2042 whole-project date kept as a soft, superseded outside date. The King Street announcement is dated Feb 22, 2023 (Bisnow's 'on Wednesday'); the October 2021 design entry says the article date is not a filing date; the July 2026 Real Deal quote was removed as a Parcel A milestone because it does not name a parcel; the unsupported 2019 mass-timber design and 365,000 GSF figure were dropped from the map notes; and claims that no Assessor lot exists were replaced with what the sources show. The board vote on the Development Agreement now shows first reading on Oct 31 and final passage on Nov 14, 2017; the Aug 11, 2026 Port Commission minutes now back the informational hearing; and the Brookfield construction halt is dated 2022 (approximate) rather than April 2022, since neither source gives the month.

item.title: Milestone · Pier 70 Parcel A: Port Commission hears an informational report (staff report dated Aug 7; no action taken) on proposed DDA amendments: parcel-specific outside dates, a Project-wide affordable rate of no less than 20% (327 stand-alone affordable units kept), 65-to-90 ft height increases on certain residential parcels, developer return cut from 18% to 14%, and a new phasing plan (Aug 11, 2026)

Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-07; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11; Port of San Francisco, 2026-08-11.
